rust_summary: the HUD as a whole, before and after its layers (`native_gui_pre`, `native_gui_post`).
doc_summary: `native_gui_pre(batch, canceled)` fires before the HUD's layers draw, each frame in a world (F1 or not, a screen open or not), and `native_gui_post(batch)` after them: NeoForge's `RenderGuiEvent.Pre` and `Post`. Draw in `pre` to go under every layer, in `post` to go over them all. Setting `canceled` in `pre` hides every layer `native_gui_layer_pre` names, and the spyglass's overlay; `post` then doesn't fire. Screens, toasts and the debug screen still draw. Bundles need "hooks": @API:gui_render@.
